rows.commentary: 0.1: Newman Nyamhuri finds early swing with the new ball, but the delivery starts from leg-stump and veers down leg for a wide.
0.1: Newman Nyamhuri shortens his length and pushes one across the right-hander, but it drifts far too wide for the umpire's call.
0.1: Newman Nyamhuri corrects his line with a shorter delivery angled across the right-hander, leaving Rahmanullah Gurbaz swinging and missing entirely.
0.2: Newman Nyamhuri lands one on a good length angling into the pads, allowing Rahmanullah Gurbaz to nudge it behind square on the on-side for a single.
0.3: Newman Nyamhuri tests Ibrahim Zadran with a delivery just outside off, catching the high part of the bat as the batter looks to drive on the rise toward mid-off.
0.4: Newman Nyamhuri completely loses his radar, spraying a delivery miles outside off to gift another wide.
0.4: Newman Nyamhuri bounces back by pulling his length back and seaming one past the outside edge of Rahmanullah Gurbaz's bat.
0.5: Newman Nyamhuri delivers a short of a good length ball angling across, which Rahmanullah Gurbaz expertly rides and steers toward backward point.
0.6: Newman Nyamhuri fires a fuller ball into the pads that Rahmanullah Gurbaz clips uppishly, just clearing a leaping Brian Bennett at mid-wicket to scamper back for two runs.
1.1: Brad Evans targets a short of a good length channel shaping away, drawing a flailing drive from Ibrahim Zadran that beats the top-edge.
1.2: Brad Evans lands it on a good length just outside off, prompting Ibrahim Zadran forward to punch the ball toward the cover region.
1.3: Brad Evans offers a length delivery outside off, and Ibrahim Zadran presses forward to drill it past the bowler and mid-off to claim the first boundary of the evening.
1.4: Brad Evans lands it on a good length to nip off the seam and strike Ibrahim Zadran flush in front, though the fervent leg-before appeal is rightfully waved away as it drifts down leg.
1.5: Brad Evans finds the breakthrough as Ibrahim Zadran drives with hard hands straight to Brian Bennett, who clings on tumbling backwards at cover to dismiss the batter for 5.
1.6: Sediqullah Atal flashes hard at a fuller delivery outside off, slicing a thick outside edge that Masuku brilliantly halts with a sliding one-handed stop to restrict them to two runs.
2.1: Masuku drops it on a short of a good length just outside off, prompting Rahmanullah Gurbaz to solidly defend the ball directly back to the bowler.
2.2: Dot ball from Masuku to Rahmanullah Gurbaz.
9.1: Sikandar Raza spears this through quicker outside off, sliding past Shahidullah Kamal's frustrated cut as it flashes alarmingly close to the paint.
9.2: Sikandar Raza strays down leg, and Shahidullah Kamal drops low to sweep this behind square with effortless precision for four.
9.3: Sikandar Raza offers a fraction of width outside off, punched cleanly in front of square by Shahidullah Kamal for a brisk single.
9.4: Sikandar Raza loops it up on off stump, inviting Azmatullah Omarzai to milk a straightforward single down to long-on.
9.5: Sikandar Raza slows it down with a whisper of turn from off, allowing Shahidullah Kamal to drop it into the vacant expanse wide of point.
9.6: Sikandar Raza darts one outside off, prompting Azmatullah Omarzai to create room and carve a square cut away for a single.
10.1: Wellington Masakadza delivers slower and wide, inviting Azmatullah Omarzai to check his drive and scoop it cleverly over cover for two runs.
10.2: Wellington Masakadza drops a full toss into the pads, whipped away into the wide spaces of mid-wicket as Azmatullah Omarzai scampers back aggressively for a second.
10.3: Wellington Masakadza fires this into the pads with extra pace, clipped neatly through mid-wicket by Azmatullah Omarzai to advance the score.
10.4: Wellington Masakadza floats this up on off, and Shahidullah Kamal swats it over mid-wicket where Burl's valiant boundary-rope acrobatics ultimately fail to prevent a maximum.
10.5: Wellington Masakadza drifts a flighted delivery onto middle and leg, worked smoothly away by Shahidullah Kamal into the gap wide of mid-wicket.
10.6: Wellington Masakadza tosses it on middle and leg, inducing a soft leading edge from Azmatullah Omarzai that rolls harmlessly back along the pitch.
11.1: Sikandar Raza floats one up outside off, and Shahidullah Kamal punches it off the back foot to backward point to pinch a quick single.
11.2: Sikandar Raza deceives Azmatullah Omarzai with a back-of-the-hand delivery that stops on the pitch, inducing an early, hard-handed stroke straight back to the bowler for a soft dismissal.
11.3: Sikandar Raza tosses it up on off stump, and Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai simply pushes the ball right back to the bowler.
11.4: Sikandar Raza imparts sharp turn back into the right-hander, forcing Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai to stay back and dead-bat it onto the on-side.
11.5: Sikandar Raza fires this one through, allowing Ijaz Ahmad Ahmadzai to turn it away square of the wicket for a single.
11.6: Sikandar Raza finishes the over as Shahidullah Kamal works the ball away towards the sweeper cover fielder for a brisk run.
0.6: Fazalhaq Farooqi bowls a back‑of‑a‑length that nudges back into the middle, and Ben Curran takes it on the back foot, turning it to mid‑wicket.
1.1: Azmatullah Omarzai unleashes a sharp inswinger that ducks back off the seam, beating Brian Bennett's back-foot flick to scamper a leg-bye.
1.2: Omarzai launches a short ball that sits up for Ben Curran, who pulls wide of mid‑on for a four, beating Ibrahim to his left.
1.3: Azmatullah Omarzai pitches it full into off stump, allowing Ben Curran to push it toward mid-off where Rashid lets it slip through.
1.4: Omarzai delivers a short ball outside off, and Brian Bennett glides it to short third‑man on the back foot, with Farooqi fumbling the dive for a single.
1.5: Omarzai bowls a back‑of‑a‑length outside off, and Ben Curran pulls it on the back foot but mistimes it to mid‑wicket.
1.6: Omarzai bowls a slower ball that lands on the pads, and Ben Curran flicks it forward to deep backward square‑leg for a run.
2.1: Farooqi bowls a wayward full toss that dips below the waist, and Ben Curran swings to short fine, missing the timing.
2.2: Farooqi bowls a short ball that Curran attempts to pull but mistimes it, and Azmatullah Omarzai takes a clean catch at mid‑wicket, dismissing Curran.
2.3: Fazalhaq Farooqi sends down a searing delivery that nips back to rap Innocent Kaia on the pads, but height saves the batter from an appeal.
2.5: Farooqi bowls a slower ball outside off, and Kaia drives it, but the thick outside edge is stopped with a dive to his left by short third‑man.
2.6: Fazalhaq Farooqi digs it in short at the stumps, catching Innocent Kaia early on the back foot as a glove takes the sting off the rocket and trickles it toward backward point for a single.
3.1: Azmatullah Omarzai serves it full just outside off, allowing Innocent Kaia to step forward and drop it softly into the covers before scampering through for a sharp single.
3.2: Azmatullah Omarzai pitches it full, and Brian Bennett charges to heave it off the thick inside half over mid-wicket, where Atal slides brilliantly near the rope to save the boundary.
3.3: Azmatullah Omarzai offers a full delivery just outside off, and Innocent Kaia strides forward with a straight bat to punch his drive straight to mid-off.
3.4: Azmatullah Omarzai strays just enough for Innocent Kaia to dispatch it with authority all the way to the deep mid-wicket fence for four.
14.3: Azmatullah Omarzai slips in a slower delivery outside off, and Tadiwanashe Marumani chips it safely toward a deep mid-off fielder for a single.
14.4: Azmatullah Omarzai digs it in short of a length outside off, allowing Ryan Burl to pull powerfully into the deep mid-wicket gap for two runs.
14.5: Azmatullah Omarzai sprays this one exceptionally wide of off stump, inviting Ryan Burl to leave it alone as the umpire signals a wide.

14.5: Azmatullah Omarzai targets the channel outside off, dragging a hack from Ryan Burl out toward long-on before a botched direct hit grants the batsman an escape after a lazy second run is abandoned.
14.6: Azmatullah Omarzai drops a full yorker wide of off-stump, allowing Tadiwanashe Marumani to softly angle the face of the bat and sprint a sharp single toward backward point.
15.1: Rashid Khan drops a flat good length delivery outside off, and Tadiwanashe Marumani rocks back to lash it wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
15.2: Rashid Khan traps Tadiwanashe Marumani lbw with a length ball outside leg stump, sealing a dismissal despite the batter missing the line.
15.3: Rashid Khan unleashes a googly from deep in the crease, allowing Wessly Madhevere to nudge it toward long-on for his first run.
15.4: Rashid Khan keeps it flat and good length outside off, where Ryan Burl steps back to pull the ball smoothly toward long-on.
15.5: Rashid Khan delivers a flat ball on a good length outside off, prompting Wessly Madhevere to create room and carve a fierce cut to deep point.
15.6: Rashid Khan tosses up a good length delivery on off, leaving Ryan Burl to tap it into the point region for a comfortable single.
16.1: Fazalhaq Farooqi induces a ferocious drive from Ryan Burl that is brilliantly intercepted by Shahidullah Kamal with a stunning one-handed catch at extra-cover.
16.2: Fazalhaq Farooqi sets the trap with a clever change of pace, leaving Brad Evans flailing into empty space on the off side.
16.3: Fazalhaq Farooqi dials down the speed once more, suffocating Brad Evans into a tame defensive prod straight back down the pitch.
